name: Rebuild website sections as Elementor templates with MiroMiro

parameters.content:
## Rebuild many website sections as Elementor templates with MiroMiro

### How it works
Rebuild many sections from many pages as Elementor templates in one run. **List Pages and Sections** holds one line per section: a page URL and a section (`hero`, `header`, `features`, `pricing`, `testimonials`, `faq`, `cta` or `footer`). **Extract Sections as Elementor** rebuilds each one in a real browser as an Elementor container with an HTML widget, styled like the original. **Keep Rebuilt Templates** names the files and drops any section that failed, listing it in `failed`, so one bad page does not stop the run. **Save Each Template as JSON** gives you one importable .json per section. Failed calls are not charged.

### Setup
This template uses the verified community node **n8n-nodes-miromiro** (tested with version 0.1.4 on n8n 1.123).
1. On n8n Cloud, search "MiroMiro" in the nodes panel (an admin may need to turn on Verified Community Nodes). Self-hosted: Settings > Community nodes > Install `n8n-nodes-miromiro`, see https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/community-nodes/installation/
2. Get a free MiroMiro API key (300 credits a month, no card): https://miromiro.app/api/onboarding
3. Open **Extract Sections as Elementor** > Credential > Create new, and paste the key.
4. Edit the list in **List Pages and Sections** and click **Execute workflow**.
5. Download each file from **Save Each Template as JSON**. In WordPress: Templates > Saved Templates > Import Templates.

Each section costs 10 credits. The same call again within 24 hours is free.

### Customization
Read the list from a Google Sheet instead of the Code node. Add a Google Drive, Dropbox or email node at the end to deliver the files. The text and images belong to the source site: replace them unless it is your site or your client's.

![The workflow, in case the preview does not load](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SoraiaBarroso/n8n-nodes-miromiro/main/docs/templates/rebuild-website-in-elementor.png)

## List what to rebuild

One line per section in **List Pages and Sections**: the page URL and the section.

## Rebuild and save

Each section becomes an Elementor template file. Failed ones are skipped and listed in `failed`.
